products.name: Learner Intervention Queue
products.product: A privacy-conscious workflow for identifying disengagement signals, assigning human outreach, and recording support outcomes during a live cohort.
products.audience: independent cohort-course creators and small training businesses
products.problem: Attendance, assignment, and community signals live in separate tools, so struggling learners are noticed late or receive generic reminders.
products.valueProposition: Combines explicit engagement signals with a human-reviewed outreach queue, support plan, next date, and outcome.
products.topic: cohort course learner engagement and intervention tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets cohort engagement tracker, student follow-up template, course completion intervention, and learner progress dashboard searches.
